summary: Stage 5 end-user QA verification for Phase A.1 failed: live application endpoints (localhost:5173 and localhost:8000) are offline, upstream SpecKit implementation for packages B01-B06 remains blocked by unratified employer decisions C03-C08, and all prerequisite packages carry critical unresolved functional, integrity, and parity defects.
